title: Memoria y justicia
goal: Read how these countries tried, imperfectly and unevenly, to reckon with the past -- Argentina's 1985 Juicio a las Juntas, its later amnesty laws and their 2003-2005 annulment, and memory sites like the former ESMA.

items: Explain what the 1985 Juicio a las Juntas achieved.
Describe what the Punto Final and Obediencia Debida laws did.

Describe what the former ESMA became.
